{{Conjecture|legends}}
A '''female''' was once involved with the [[Human/Legends|Human]] brothers [[Vallkos]] and [[Mallikhan]]. [[Gender/Legends|She]] was the cause of a fierce rivalry between the siblings, each of whom was the leader of a [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] group&mdash;the [[Crimson Stars]] and the [[Ebon Strikers]], respectively&mdash;based on the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Volik]]. Eventually, the conflict between the two gangs came close to an explosive outbreak of violence.<ref name="TUR">''[[The Unknown Regions]]''</ref>
{{RPGseed}}
A group of individuals sought out the female during that [[Time/Legends|time]] in order for her to help them [[Diplomat/Legends|mediate]] the situation on Volik.<ref name="TUR" />
{{Endgame}}
